name: FREN 3250
title: Global Culture in French I
description: Intense study of oral French. Learning of oral techniques of communication in conjunction with weekly topics of conversation associated with various francophone cultures. Rigorous and active oral practice through dialogues, interviews, roundtables, and oral reports.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: FREN 1104 or 1175 or three years high school French or instructor consent.
